entries.00ef7e18512742b3: This business franchises the university preparatory cram school “Kawai Juku Manabis,” which combines video lessons with “learning navigation” (personal support) for current high school students. entries.1b4bc9f392645253: The core Mori Juku combines one-on-one tutoring with up to two students per teacher and a 'grade guarantee system' for junior high school students. The 'Foresta' teaching materials originated in Mori Juku classrooms and were developed from two perspectives: ease of understanding for students and ease of teaching for teachers; they are also used by education-related companies outside the group. Its operations are distinguished by improving and systematizing teaching methods and materials based on analysis of test results, teaching content and the effectiveness of instructors' guidance.

entries.b579070d8ac7367a: This business operates “Mori-juku,” a tutoring-style cram school for elementary, junior high and high school students in which one teacher instructs up to two students. For junior high school students, it has introduced a “grade guarantee program” that guarantees a rise of 20 points or more in one subject on regular exams. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,562 million, and as of September 30, 2025, it operated 249 directly managed campuses.
entries.b961b5e33b01e133: In the education services industry, education system reform is progressing amid declining birthrates, and the need for new forms of education and instruction using IT technology is growing. Responding to a more diverse admissions environment, including the de facto free tuition for private high schools, designated-school recommendations and comprehensive selection, is also required. External revenue of the company's group for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥18,562 million for Mori Juku, ¥9,295 million for Shonan Seminar, ¥3,355 million for Kawai Juku Manabis and ¥3,914 million for Other, with the one-on-one tutoring-type Mori Juku the largest.
entries.c8e3a207230117a0: Under its corporate mission, 'Renew life through education,' the company plans to continue opening Mori Juku, its core business, while promoting franchising of 'Jiritsu Gakushu RED' and carrying out systematic recruitment and development of personnel. In its other businesses, the company aims to maintain earnings and expand them over the medium to long term through growth investment in expanding sales channels, developing new content, IT adoption and the basic academic skills business.

entries.f24f64b0d6fd77a0: In the fiscal year ended September 2025, Mori Juku opened 20 new campuses, bringing the total to 249 campuses, and enrolled students rose to 61,781, an increase of 6,424 from the same period of the previous year. Shonan Seminar had 200 campuses and 18,697 students, and Kawai Juku Manabis had 51 campuses and 5,492 students. New openings and growth in student numbers are reflected in the expansion of cram school services centered on Mori Juku.
entries.fbdb0a38d231e20f: This business operates the cram school “Shonan Zeminaru,” which mainly uses group instruction for elementary, junior high and high school students. It offers various courses, from regular exam preparation to preparation for entrance exams to highly competitive schools, using its original “QE” lesson style. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥9,295 million, and as of September 30, 2025, it operated 200 campuses, centered on Kanagawa Prefecture, where it was founded. The business is carried out by consolidated subsidiary Shonan Zeminaru.
